text:
Isa: Quick idea 47b: tiny winter swap? Leave a scarf on the hook by the kitchen, take one if you need a cozy rescue. Also hot-chocolate poll below.
Jordan: Love it. Can we make it "scarves & scarves only" (no rogue sweaters) :sweater: ?
Maya: Agreed. Also: hot chocolate preference poll: React :one: for classic cocoa, :two: for spiced chai cocoa, :three: for vegan almond cocoa.
Omar: One for spiced chai. Also will bring a jar of marshmallows.
Isa: Thanks Omar! I'll pin a tiny note to the hook "Take one, leave one (or socks)" haha.
Jordan: Posted a photo of the scarf pile. Mostly mismatched but full of personality.
Maya: Added cookie-bite stickers to indicate "home-baked" so people know provenance.
snack-bot: Reminder scheduled: Wed 15:30 in #random 4dd "Scarves & Hot Chocolate Hour in kitchen" :white_check_mark:
Omar: Poll leaning 2, but I'm bringing both just in case. Who's up for a 3pm meet-up to taste-test?
Isa: I'll be there with extra spoons and a tiny playlist of holiday guilty-pleasure songs.
Jordan: Bringing a tiny repair kit too (needle + thread) in case someone wants to fix a loose button on a scarf.
Maya: This is a very practical cozy committee. See you all Wednesday! :mug_with_steam: :scarf:
